profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. describes itself as a company that owns, operates, and scales purpose-built businesses acquiring, deploying, and monetizing specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. Its website says this portfolio provides direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies like AI and Bitcoin mining. The site also states that Hut 8 fully commercialized a 1 GW Beacon Point AI Data Center Campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, bringing campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 Billion.

The company's public positioning centers on AI data center infrastructure and Bitcoin mining. The Beacon Point AI Data Center Campus is the only AI-related asset named on the site. No products or MCP servers are listed for the company.

Hut 8 Corp. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Miami, Florida, trading under ticker HUT, with SEC CIK number 0001964789. No cases are listed for the company, and a Florida law exposure count of 96 is recorded. The company is also listed under the alias HUT 8 CORP.
